name: IC Interface — I2C, 3.6V — TSSOP
description: Surface-mount I2C interface IC component cluster in a TSSOP package family featuring 3.6V operation and footprint TSSOP-16_4.4x5mm_P0.65mm.
selection_hints: Select when an I2C interface IC operating at 3.6V in a TSSOP package is needed.
Verify compatibility with the TSSOP-16_4.4x5mm_P0.65mm footprint for SMD mounting.
Use when tier A interface parts from kicad-symbols such as TCAL6408PW are preferred.
avoid_when: The application requires an interface standard other than I2C.
The design requires through-hole mounting instead of SMD.
A package family other than TSSOP or a footprint different from TSSOP-16_4.4x5mm_P0.65mm is required.
